items.title: Veeva (VEEV) Stock May Be 17% Undervalued On Cash Flow Expectations
items.summary: Veeva Systems has delivered a 50.8% gain over the past three years, yet the recent pullback in the share price puts fresh attention on a simple issue: whether that track record lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate. With the stock now around US$266 a share, the core question is how much of Veeva Systems' future cash flows are already baked into that price.
